command.reason: Reviewed the actual contributor source and protected build attempt 1 against Core release 0xed101352062708f9c783aaf7b52fb752d98c5a5a2b0c3955ed14ab7feefa5497. The freshly authenticated host manifest matches the reviewed proposal exactly. All nine encoded configuration fields are source-fixed, including zero fixedQuoteAsset. The Host quote address remains a launch input. The exact fixed configuration hash is admitted by two distinct positive quote cases; the same configuration without Host fixed admission is rejected. Initial pricing and infrastructure cannot be overridden. Original backend and product validators reconstructed the actual protected artifact. Complete runtime and constructor immutable mappings remain unchanged from the independently reviewed Fixed engine source. The two fixtures are worker instances, not production deployments. The reviewed PoolManager, PositionManager, Planner, ForwarderFactory and Converter are fixed. A non-WETH quote uses its own address followed by the fixed fee-500 WETH route. Constructor decimal and price limits, current fee-market qualification, source/dependency code checks and converter backing remain required for each real quote. No arbitrary ERC20 safety, immutable proxy governance or future liquidity claim is made. Only the two actual exact-input BUY/SELL permissions are proposed, with moneyRights=3 and coinRights=0. Both positive quote cases prove bound result/state/input/output/replay and backed fees; wrong route, excessive fee floor, zero minimum and stale fee market revert. Host-only dispatch and dependency checks remain unchanged. This synchronous quote profile has no request/fulfillment queue or added withdrawal authority. The original Host nonce, rollback and durable wallet-journal recovery apply. Actual production trades, finality and provider availability remain to be observed. The single eligible family is this actual contributor-owned functional Quote family, shared with Fixed. The proposed platform split is 10 protocol plus 20 author basis points, matching the protected vectors. This does not fabricate a supersedes relation, a Native RegistryV2 eligibility field or fees for an unrelated family. Approval binds this build and manifest only; publication, real launch/trade/claim evidence, finality and public availability remain separate.

command.reason: Reviewed the actual contributor settlement source, the original independent plan review and the completed protected build against Core release 0xed101352062708f9c783aaf7b52fb752d98c5a5a2b0c3955ed14ab7feefa5497. Fresh authenticated manifest equals the reviewed proposal. The constructor requires exactly 96 configuration bytes, quote equality with the Host context, minimumWindow=60 and maximumWindow=2592000. The schema keeps only quoteAsset editable; the wrapper independently rejects raw fixed-window override. The Host revision intentionally permits varying quote/configuration, without an initial operation. Both original artifact validators passed. The actual inherited entrypoint uses constructor-only storage for context and windows, with no runtime immutable patches to reinterpret. Source and complete bytecode match the stored package and original independent plan review. External asset interactions are IERC20 balanceOf and SafeERC20 transfer. Exact inbound Host funding, exact engine and recipient deltas, and balance >= totalLiability are required; unsupported fee-on-transfer or rebasing behavior may prevent operation. There is no oracle or market-price dependency. Asset upgrade, freeze and chain liveness remain external dependencies. Only quote-asset moneyRights=2 and coinRights=0 are allowed. REQUEST records a funded amount, original payer, fixed beneficiary, expiry and obligation. FULFILL requires the launch creator, a nonzero evidence hash and exact fixed payout; REFUND requires the original payer and exact payout. Host-only execution, global nonce and per-request terminal states prevent unauthorized replay or redirection. The exact four-case protected build proves request, creator fulfillment, expiry refund, liability conservation and fourteen expected operation reverts. Fulfillment is forbidden at or after expiry; payer refund begins at expiry. Creator attestation is explicitly not oracle proof. No admin withdrawal or promised recovery from an externally frozen asset exists. Only this distinct functional settlement family is proposed for fee eligibility. Protected platform30 economics do not prove that a settlement charged a trade fee: this engine reports no invented swap fees. Each launch and engine keeps its own requests, token context and liability; no shared funds or Quote-family entitlement is added. Approval binds this build and manifest only; onchain publication, actual funded request/fulfillment/refund, finality and public availability remain separate.
